_conventions: Cells are [x, y], origin top-left, x 0..19, y 0..11. A move between two different areas (room <-> corridor, or room <-> room) is only allowed between a door's 'cell' and its 'outside'. guardRoute is ordered and loops from the last cell back to the first, one cell per second. Stepping onto a loot cell picks that object up; stepping onto an exit cell banks whatever you carry.
